serviceDescription: InfusionPoints provides cybersecurity, compliance, and cloud security advisory services focused on helping organizations achieve and maintain FedRAMP, Federal, Defense, and other regulated compliance requirements. Services span the full lifecycle of cloud security and compliance programs, including readiness assessments, architecture and engineering guidance, control implementation, documentation development, audit support, continuous monitoring, risk management, compliance strategy, and authorization acceleration. InfusionPoints supports organizations pursuing FedRAMP, FedRAMP 20x, DoD SRG, CMMC, NIST 800-53, FISMA, StateRAMP, and related compliance initiatives.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Advisory support for FedRAMP 20x implementations, machine-readable evidence development, continuous compliance approaches, and alignment with evolving FedRAMP requirements.

XBU40 is InfusionPoints' FedRAMP Certified Continuous Trust Platform offering designed to accelerate customer adoption of secure and compliant cloud services. The platform aligns with FedRAMP 20x Class C requirements as well as Rev5 high and DoD IL4/5 and provides a compliance-ready foundation that helps organizations reduce authorization effort, inherit implemented security capabilities, and streamline their path to Federal and Defense cloud deployments. XBU40 supports customers operating under Department of Defense Provisional Authorizations (PAs) and other highly regulated environments.
Design and implementation guidance for secure cloud environments on AWS and other cloud platforms, including reference architectures and security control implementation.

Strategic and technical guidance for organizations pursuing FedRAMP authorization, including roadmap development, readiness planning, authorization strategy, program governance, and compliance consulting.
Gap analyses, maturity assessments, and readiness evaluations against FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, DoD SRG, FISMA, and related cybersecurity frameworks.
Development and review of security and compliance documentation including SSPs, policies, procedures, plans, diagrams, inventories, and supporting authorization artifacts.
Preparation and support for independent assessments, audits, and authorization reviews, including evidence collection, remediation support, and assessor coordination.
Guidance for ongoing compliance operations including vulnerability management, POA&M management, change management, reporting, and continuous monitoring programs.
Advisory and operational support for security monitoring, incident response, managed compliance activities, and security operations center functions.
Consulting services supporting DoD SRG impact levels, CMMC, DFARS, and other defense-related cybersecurity and compliance requirements.
Enterprise risk management, cybersecurity governance, third-party risk management, compliance program development, and executive advisory services.
